decision_log.decision: Calendar: use the Google Workspace MCP server (calendar events scope), NOT the search-only google-maps MCP. The maps package exposes places/directions search, not calendar invites, so it cannot satisfy create_invite.
decision_log.rejected: server-google-maps/calendar (places search only, no event creation)

decision_log.decision: Notion: use the official Notion MCP server. Community forks drift and lack pages/databases create parity needed by create_notion_page/create_workspace.

Jira/Slack/HRIS/email stay behind the self-hosted n8n MCP Server Trigger (N8N_MCP_URL) so one credential vault + one audit surface covers all four; each tool keeps its own wrapper in backend/executor/tools/ so an MCP-to-direct-API swap is contained.
decision_log.rejected: per-vendor direct APIs in Phase 3-4 (credential sprawl before pilot)

spike.calendar: create_invite sandbox echo returned event id
spike.notion: create_notion_page sandbox echo returned page id
